summary: News Corporation filed an 8-K to disclose information provided to the Australian Securities Exchange regarding its ongoing stock repurchase program, authorized for up to $1 billion of Class A and Class B common stock. The filing notes daily ASX disclosure requirements and reiterates management's intent to repurchase shares from time to time. No specific terms, prices, or dates are stated. This is a routine capital return disclosure, not a tender offer. Watch for periodic updates and repurchase execution pace; no risk-arb angle as it is not M&A.
